canonical.title: Day-trips within 30 km of d'Eugénie à Emilie

parent.title: A weekend in Baudour, anchored on dinner at d'Eugénie à Émilie

siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near d'Eugénie à Émilie
siblings.summary: Triple E — the Fernez family's three-room boutique inn directly across the square — is the only real walk-home bed; everything else is a 3 km+ taxi.

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of d'Eugénie à Émilie
siblings.summary: Eight character properties near the 2-star d'Eugénie à Émilie — from an 18th-c Spanish farm in the same commune to a converted neo-Gothic chapel in Mons and underwater rooms at Pairi Daiza.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of d'Eugénie à Émilie
siblings.summary: The 30 km bubble around Baudour is anchored on Mons — Le CLICK and the Initialis science park host the flagships (DevDay 3 Dec, DevFest 27 Nov, Forum Innovation & Cloud); Valenciennes's Serre Numérique grazes the edge.
